note: Upstream code is cloned next to this repository so both worktrees share one copy. Keep each checkout at the commit below during the comparison; record any change in external/patches/.

cc-csi.upstream_install: Put MaxwellFDFD on the MATLAB path, then run add_path.m. Upstream tested MATLAB R2019a.

brg.upstream_install: Needs gfortran and GNU make. Run `make install` to build the MEX files, then startup.m in MATLAB; tests/test_all.m checks the build.
